entity.name: CryptoStrapon
entity.description: CryptoStrapon is a small team that investigates real crypto scams and turns them into free, open tools and plain-language guides. We maintain npm-install-audit, an open source pre-install checker for unfamiliar JavaScript projects, plus an open scam quiz and glossary.

projects.name: npm-install-audit
projects.description: A zero-dependency, read-only Node.js scanner that checks a project you did not write before you run npm, yarn or pnpm install: install hooks, git hooks, registry overrides and auth tokens in .npmrc, yarnPath and .yarnrc yarn-path delegation, .pnpmfile.cjs, risky script settings and dependencies that bypass the npm registry. Available as a CLI on npm and as a GitHub Action. Its checklist is part of the OWASP NPM Security Cheat Sheet and the Security Alliance (SEAL) Frameworks.

channels.description: Bank transfer. Account details are shared privately on request.

plans.name: Maintenance and new checks for 2027
plans.description: Twelve months of maintenance: new checks as attack techniques change (package manager configs, editor and agent auto-run files), cross-platform CI, faster triage of community pull requests and issues, and documentation for teams that review unfamiliar repositories before install.
